description: List the boards on one connected Pinterest account. Every Pin needs a board: call this before creating a Pinterest post and pass the board id in platformMetadata.pinterest.boardIdByAccount keyed by the same account id.

accountId.description: Pinterest account id — the `id` of a platform='pinterest' entry from list_social_accounts

privacy.description: Only boards with this privacy. Omit for all.

name: list_pinterest_boards
title: List Pinterest boards
